thread:
alex: Morning — quick check: vendor said UK-west standby slots will clear tomorrow EOD, but invoice is stuck pending PO. Can we still schedule the morning canary for 07:00 UTC?
morgan: PO? who's blocking the PO now?
tara: Finance flagged the invoice for 3rd-party vendor verification. I pinged finance@ with the vendor docs, waiting on their reply. ETA today afternoon.
alex: if finance doesn't clear, we can fall back to a soft-borrow from US-west demo pool. Latency delta ~30ms, acceptable for canary.
jay: soft-borrow needs a terraform toggle + tenant tag changes. I can apply, but need approval to touch infra during the 06:00-09:00 window.
morgan: i'm fine with the toggle. @jay please include a rollback plan.
jay: rollback plan: revert module gcp_alloc.soft_borrow = false, run `./infra/terraform apply -target=module.gcp_alloc` — should be quick. i'll post PR now.
procurement-bot: Payment reminder: invoice #INV-3421 requires PO. Visit https://pay.example.com/inv/INV-3421 to upload PO.
alex: thanks. @tara can you update finance thread with "need PO for INV-3421 to keep morning canary on UK-west"? add tag "urgent-demo"
tara: done — finance replied: can approve if vendor provides bank details and updated W9. I forwarded to vendor.
morgan: while we wait, can we run a dry-run of the canary on US-west to validate telemetry? no cost change.
jay: yes i'll spin up canary cluster in us-west2, run the smoke script:
```bash
./scripts/run_canary.sh --profile demo --region us-west2 --count 50
```
alex: perfect. capture latency traces to /tmp/canary-traces-$(date +%s). Don't forget token masking.
sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance window lock: 06:00-09:00 UTC. Any infra changes must be approved by oncall.
alex: noted. @morgan i'll wait for PR + oncall ok then trigger borrow.
morgan: oncall ok from my side, will watch for the PR.
jay: PR posted: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/infra/merge/1234 — includes tf changes + revert script.
tara: vendor sent updated bank details, W9 attached. Finance says they can clear PO if we ack the canary run and note fallback path.
alex: acked. Let's proceed with dry-run in us-west2. If green, we will retry UK-west once PO is in.
morgan: 👍
alex: (later) dry-run completed — traces look clean, no QoS regressions. tagging results to the incident channel.
jay: will stand down after green and hold UK-west until finance confirms.
tara: finance cleared PO at 16:12 UTC. vendor confirmed they will release slots by 18:00 UTC.
alex: thanks team. scheduling canary in UK-west for 18:30 UTC to allow handoff. I'll post a short summary to #incidents after completion. :rocket:
